crossRefs.note: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.
I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met…

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
translations.bsb: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
translations.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
translations.asv: Pilate therefore went out unto them, and saith, What accusation bring ye against this man?
